name: agents-md
title: Living AGENTS.md Operational Memory
description: Living operational memory and agent-facing context maintained at the repository root.

sections.name: Architectural Topology & Jurisdictions
sections.description: Repository tier, external interfaces, and jurisdictional boundaries (strict separation of concerns).

sections.name: Global Operational Invariants
sections.description: Project-level invariants such as non-interactive execution guards, Conventional Commits, and branch conventions.

sections.name: Builder Precautions & Gotchas
sections.description: Toolchain quirks, compiler limitations, and test runner constraints.

sections.name: Reviewer Precautions & Checklist
sections.description: Public verification guidelines and regression checkpoints (strictly excluding confidential test secrets).

sections.name: Active State & In-Flight Context
sections.description: Pre-commit baseline observation with mandatory provenance (Observed-At: <UTC timestamp> @ <base-revision-id>), dirty status, recent milestones, and next pickup item.

name: build-plan
title: Build Plan
description: Task-specific implementation plan authored and persisted in the out-of-tree plan vault (~/.agentplaybook/<project>/plan/) and provided to Builder after single internal technical PLAN_REVIEW_PASS (retaining both concept/method and interaction-contract review gates strictly for opt-in legacy Blueprint flows), mechanically bound to its exact SHA-256 byte digest via the Reviewer-originated plan-approval record.

path_variables.timestamp: UTC ISO timestamp formatted as YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ

sections.name: Goal & Root Intent
sections.description: Core purpose of the task, user problem being solved, and intended behavioral changes.

sections.name: In-Scope Files
sections.description: Exact files and modules Builder is authorized to modify or create.

sections.name: Out-of-Scope Files
sections.description: Areas, files, or subsystems that must not be altered.

sections.name: Implementation Steps
sections.description: Ordered minimal code modifications required to complete the goal.

sections.name: Acceptance Criteria
sections.description: Concrete conditions that determine successful implementation.

sections.name: TDD Scenarios
sections.description: Public Given/When/Then scenarios driving implementation and test verification; stated before implementation begins.

sections.name: Interaction Contracts
sections.description: Scenario-first, Builder-visible declarations for actual interacting symbols only: contract ID and purpose; owning package and consumer; structs with named fields/types; interfaces with interacting methods; and functions with body-free signatures and named typed parameters. Record return names/types or explicit none, error outcomes including no error, Given/When/Then scenario IDs and observable outcomes, and relevant side effects. Include ordered reuse evidence and link each principal function to usable or planned helpers. A phase-1 draft may mark this section pending contract review, but Builder handoff requires finalized contracts or a Reviewer-approved concrete not-applicable rationale; never include implementation bodies.

sections.name: Local Verification Commands
sections.description: Exact test commands Builder must execute and pass locally before submission.

sections.name: E2E Verification
sections.description: Explicit declaration of E2E verification requirements (required vs not-required with rationale), purpose/scope, stable scenario IDs, preconditions, steps, observable expected result, verification, total time budget, environment/platform/toolchain, exact entrypoint, expected outputs, readiness/startup timeout, cleanup owner/action, retry/recovery, allowed skips, credential policy, and acceptance criteria; CI is optional.

sections.name: Architectural View (Optional)
sections.description: Optional architectural Blueprint view inside the single task plan for multi-component features without entering the legacy Blueprint lifecycle.

name: review-plan
title: Review Plan
description: Reviewer-only verification plan persisted in the out-of-tree plan vault (~/.agentplaybook/<project>/plan/) and used for independent validation during code review.

path_variables.timestamp: UTC ISO timestamp formatted as YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ

sections.name: Verification Scope
sections.description: Files, boundaries, and acceptance criteria to be validated against.

sections.name: Invariants & Boundaries
sections.description: Architectural rules, non-functional requirements, and anti-cheating invariants to uphold.

sections.name: Interaction Contract Review
sections.description: Reviewer-only independent verification paths for each public interaction contract or not-applicable rationale, including scenario-to-boundary traceability, typed contract completeness, ordered reuse evidence, helper locality/abstraction, and principal-function/helper links. A phase-1 draft may mark this section pending; final criteria remain private to Planner and Reviewer.

sections.name: Edge Cases & Failure Scenarios
sections.description: Boundary conditions, invalid inputs, concurrency issues, or potential error states to test.

sections.name: Review Verification Commands
sections.description: Commands Reviewer executes to independently inspect diffs and test suites.

sections.name: Track B Definition
sections.description: Optional specification of complete action boundary defining exact fields: action, boundary, baseline_identity, environment, metrics, sampling, and criteria for performance-quality or supply-chain differential verification.

sections.name: E2E Coverage
sections.description: Independent mapping of every public scenario and acceptance criterion to a review verification path, or independent verification of the documented not-required rationale.

sections.name: Shared Contracts & Invariants

sections.name: Outcome

name: review-findings
title: Review Findings
description: Structured findings reported by Reviewer to Planner upon identifying review issues; quarantined within private review communication and out-of-tree plan vault (~/.agentplaybook/<project>/plan/).

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the finding (e.g. ISSUE-1).

fields.name: location
fields.description: File path and line number or code symbol.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Severity level: Blocker, Major, Minor, or Other.

fields.name: evidence_mode
fields.description: Mode of verification evidence: behavioral (Track A reproduction) or static (specification reference, lint report, design audit, or Track B differential summary).

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: Concrete observable verification evidence such as test assertion failure output, static rule violation, or differential measurement.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Clear explanation of the detected problem or deviation from the review plan.

fields.name: expected_behavior
fields.description: Expected correct behavior or contract requirement.

fields.name: reproduction_scenario
fields.description: Steps or input conditions needed for Builder to write a reproduction test (required for behavioral findings, omitted for non-behavioral findings).

name: plan-approval
title: Plan Approval
description: Structured approval message issued by Reviewer to mechanically bind an approved Builder-visible plan to its exact SHA-256 byte digest, forwarded unchanged by Planner to Builder.

fields.name: approval_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the approval record.

fields.name: gate
fields.description: Approval gate identifier (PLAN_REVIEW_PASS for ordinary single-plan work or CONTRACT_REVIEW_PASS for legacy Blueprint JIT sub-plans).

fields.name: decision
fields.description: Passing gate decision affirming plan acceptance.

fields.name: plan_path
fields.description: Canonical vault-relative path to the approved plan file.

fields.name: sha256
fields.description: Lowercase 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 digest computed over the exact bytes of the approved plan file.

fields.name: reviewer_peer_id
fields.description: Peer session identity of the Reviewer that evaluated the plan and issued the approval.

fields.name: reviewed_at_utc
fields.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the review was concluded and approval issued.

name: review-resolution
title: Review Resolution
description: Planner-owned post-review synthesis persisted in the out-of-tree plan vault (~/.agentplaybook/<project>/plan/) capturing master composition review outcomes, resolved findings, deviations, residual risks, and verification evidence across all completed sub-plans. Visible to Planner, Builder, Reviewer, and Navigator only after Planner sanitization; shared resolution content strictly excludes review-plan criteria, hidden test fixtures, and private inspection methods.

path_variables.timestamp: UTC ISO timestamp formatted as YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ

sections.name: Outcome
sections.description: Final review disposition: APPROVED, WAIVED, or REVISED; reflects internal technical approval and records external review status (or that repository is not externally assessed).

sections.name: Resolved Findings
sections.description: Structured disposition and verification references for all reported review findings.

sections.name: Deviations & Rationales
sections.description: Documented waivers, plan amendments, and architectural deviation rationales.

sections.name: Residual Risks
sections.description: Identified non-blocking risks, technical debt, or follow-up milestones.

sections.name: Verification Evidence
sections.description: Sanitized summary of green Track A tests, verified static evidence, and Track B measurements.

name: scout-survey
title: Scout Reconnaissance Survey
description: Transient message artifact containing read-only architectural topography, evidence, and structural survey delivered by Scout to Planner during cold-start reconnaissance or large-scale exploration.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the survey pass

fields.name: provenance
fields.description: Surveyed repository revision ID, UTC timestamp, and explored path or subsystem scope

fields.name: repository_topology
fields.description: Observed directory structure, primary entry points, module hierarchy, and component layout

fields.name: module_boundaries
fields.description: Identified public interfaces, exposed API/CLI symbols, and subsystem boundary contracts

fields.name: build_and_toolchains
fields.description: Detected build tools, compiler configurations, package dependencies, and test runners

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: Factual evidence list including inspected file paths, extracted symbols, and verification commands

fields.name: uncertainties
fields.description: Identified unknowns, ambiguous areas, low-confidence inferences, and items requiring Planner ground-truth verification

name: diagram-brief
title: Diagram Brief
description: Self-contained structured specification message dispatched to Cartographer defining visual requirements, target path, complete architectural semantics, and summary takeaways without requiring exploratory codebase/doc reading.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Descriptive title of the architectural diagram.

fields.name: target_path
fields.description: Target persistence path strictly matching docs/diagrams/<safe-name>.html.

fields.name: semantic_spec
fields.description: Self-contained semantic architectural specification providing all entities/nodes, relationships, directional flows, labels, and boundary groupings required for visual synthesis without codebase exploration.

fields.name: focal_nodes
fields.description: Key focal components or nodes requiring accent emphasis.

fields.name: summary_takeaways
fields.description: Key architectural takeaways the diagram must communicate.

name: diagram-completion
title: Diagram Completion Message
description: Lightweight completion signal emitted by Cartographer containing persistent file URI, single-sentence summary digest, and node/edge statistics; strictly prohibits inline HTML/SVG markup to guarantee zero context pollution.

fields.name: uri
fields.description: Persistent file URI for the rendered diagram under docs/diagrams/.

fields.name: digest
fields.description: Single-sentence plain text summary digest (<100 tokens evaluated by deterministic subword estimator EstimateTokenCount, <=250 chars, <=60 words) with zero inline HTML/SVG markup.

fields.name: statistics
fields.description: Node and edge count statistics and layout dimensions.

name: diagram-clarification-request
title: Diagram Clarification Request
description: Structured clarification inquiry message dispatched by Cartographer to commissioner (Planner or Navigator) requesting targeted disambiguation of brief entities, flows, or boundary constraints without exploratory codebase exploration.

fields.name: brief_title
fields.description: Title of the referenced diagram-brief under inquiry.

fields.name: ambiguity_context
fields.description: Specific entity, relationship, or boundary exhibiting ambiguity or contradiction.

fields.name: identified_gap
fields.description: Concrete architectural missing piece or conflicting constraint preventing visual layout computation.

fields.name: clarification_question
fields.description: Exact targeted question for commissioner (Planner or Navigator) regarding intended entities, flows, or directions.

name: e2e-brief
title: E2E Verification Brief
description: Structured execution specification message dispatched by Planner to Verifier defining candidate revision, test package, command, scenarios, skip policy, environment/readiness, expected outputs, cleanup obligations, credential policy/authorization, time budget, and prior cleanup resolution.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: Correlated fresh unique E2E run identifier.

fields.name: repo_ref
fields.description: Canonical repository path or origin identity.

fields.name: candidate_ref
fields.description: Immutable repository candidate commit SHA (40-character hex).

fields.name: test_package
fields.description: Safe repository-relative path rooted at e2e/.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Execution mode enum: 'build-and-run' or 'run-only'.

fields.name: command
fields.description: Exact test execution command argv (e.g. ['go', 'test', '-count=1', './e2e/...']).

fields.name: build_command
fields.description: Exact artifact build command argv.

fields.name: timeout_ms
fields.description: Total execution timeout in milliseconds (>0).

fields.name: go_version
fields.description: Required Go toolchain version string.

fields.name: platforms
fields.description: Target execution platforms and architectures.

fields.name: dependency_lock_ref
fields.description: Dependency lock digest (sha256:<64 hex>) or explicit sentinel 'NONE'.

fields.name: environment
fields.description: Declared environment inputs with non-secret literal values, service bindings, or injected credential references.

fields.name: expected_outputs
fields.description: Declared machine-readable output filenames or paths relative to run storage.

fields.name: scenarios
fields.description: Complete list of scenario contracts with unique IDs, preconditions, steps, expected results, and verification.

fields.name: allowed_skip_ids
fields.description: Explicit subset of unique scenario IDs permitted to be skipped; empty list allows no skips.

fields.name: services
fields.description: External service dependencies with pinned image/version or endpoint, ready condition, and startup timeout.

fields.name: cleanup_obligations
fields.description: Explicit teardown obligations covering services, test data, processes, namespaces, and credentials.

fields.name: credential_policy
fields.description: Declared credential entities with unique ASCII kebab-case identifiers, generation mode (THROWAWAY vs real-only), and generation instructions; provider and break-glass credentials remain unconditionally prohibited.

fields.name: credential_authorization
fields.description: Explicit per-name human authorization records required if and only if REAL_ONLY credentials are used; carries purpose, single-run lifetime, authorizer, and immutable authorization reference matching ATTESTED:MIXED names exactly, rejecting any extra or missing name.

fields.name: prior_cleanup_resolution
fields.description: Human resolution record for unconfirmed cleanup from a prior run; required when prior cleanup is unresolved.

name: e2e-report
title: E2E Verification Report
description: Sole complete structured verification result emitted by Verifier (or finalized by controller on runner loss) containing execution status, scenario metrics and results, run-scoped storage evidence URI, cleanup status and evidence, secrets attestation, and sanitized diagnostic; strictly prohibits raw test log dumps.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: Correlated unique E2E run identifier.

fields.name: repo_ref
fields.description: Canonical repository path or origin identity.

fields.name: candidate_ref
fields.description: Immutable repository candidate commit SHA (40-character hex).

fields.name: test_package
fields.description: Repository-relative path to execution package under e2e/.

fields.name: stage_outcome
fields.description: Overall stage outcome enum: PASS, BUILD_FAILURE, PRODUCT_FAILURE, ENV_BLOCKED, CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED, TIMEOUT, CANCELLED, RUNNER_LOST, INVALID_EVIDENCE.

fields.name: build_outcome
fields.description: Build stage outcome enum: PASS, FAIL, NOT_RUN, UNKNOWN, ENV_ERROR, TIMEOUT, CANCELLED.

fields.name: execution_outcome
fields.description: Execution stage outcome enum: PASS, FAIL, NOT_RUN, UNKNOWN, ENV_ERROR, TIMEOUT, CANCELLED, INVALID_EVIDENCE.

fields.name: scenarios_selected
fields.description: Total scenarios selected for run as an integer string.

fields.name: scenarios_passed
fields.description: Total scenarios passed as an integer string.

fields.name: scenarios_failed
fields.description: Total scenarios failed as an integer string.

fields.name: scenarios_skipped
fields.description: Total scenarios skipped as an integer string.

fields.name: scenarios_not_run
fields.description: Total scenarios not run as an integer string.

fields.name: scenarios_unknown
fields.description: Total scenarios with unknown outcome at termination (e.g. runner loss during execution) as an integer string.

fields.name: scenario_results
fields.description: Embedded scenario execution results with stable scenario ID and outcome (PASS, FAIL, SKIP, NOT_RUN, UNKNOWN) for each approved scenario.

fields.name: result_completeness
fields.description: Execution result completeness enum: COMPLETE, PARTIAL, NONE.

fields.name: tested_artifact_ref
fields.description: Tested binary/artifact SHA-256 digest and provenance descriptor (format: 'sha256:<hex>;candidate=<40-hex>;build_material=sha256:<hex>;source=FRESH|VERIFIED_REUSE' or sentinel 'NONE').

fields.name: execution_material_ref
fields.description: SHA-256 digest over canonical JSON execution material manifest or sentinel 'UNAVAILABLE'.

fields.name: duration_ms
fields.description: Total execution duration in milliseconds as an integer string.

fields.name: diagnostic
fields.description: Bounded error diagnostic message or single-sentence outcome summary (<=160 bytes, single UTF-8 line, no raw logs or credentials).

fields.name: evidence_uri
fields.description: Persistent run-scoped evidence URI, or explicit sentinel 'UNAVAILABLE' when run terminates prior to evidence storage.

fields.name: cleanup_status
fields.description: Cleanup disposition enum: CONFIRMED or UNCONFIRMED.

fields.name: cleanup_evidence_uri
fields.description: Persistent cleanup-record URI, or sentinel 'NOT_REQUIRED' when cleanup was not required and status is CONFIRMED.

fields.name: secrets_attestation
fields.description: Secrets hygiene attestation for the run in canonical forms: NOT_PROVISIONED sha256:<hex> when credential provisioning was not started or policy is empty (digest input is sorted lines name:<GenerationMode>\n for every declared policy entry, or empty bytes for empty policy); ATTESTED:THROWAWAY sha256:<hex> when every credential is locally generated throwaway; ATTESTED:MIXED:<names> sha256:<hex> when narrow-exception real values were used; ENV_BLOCKED:<code> with a closed reason code (GENERATOR_UNAVAILABLE, AUTHORIZATION_DENIED, PROVISIONING_FAILED) when provisioning could not complete; or UNVERIFIED:RUNNER_LOST when runner loss occurred with incomplete provisioning. Names are specification credential policy entity identifiers, sorted in lexicographic byte order, unique with duplicates rejected, comma-joined with no spaces; digest input for ATTESTED forms is the sorted names joined by single newlines with trailing newline, UTF-8 encoded. Raw error text is prohibited in the attestation and remains in quarantined logs referenced by name only.

name: e2e-clarification-request
title: E2E Clarification Request
description: Structured inquiry message emitted by Verifier to Planner when execution instructions are missing, ambiguous, or contradictory.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: Correlated E2E run identifier.

fields.name: test_package
fields.description: Referenced package path under e2e/.

fields.name: missing_instruction
fields.description: Ambiguous, missing, or contradictory setup/execution detail.

fields.name: clarification_question
fields.description: Targeted question for Planner regarding intended execution configuration.

name: external-review-report
title: External Review Report
description: Planner-private message artifact containing structured findings from user-requested External Reviewer on a fixed candidate revision or revision set; Planner sanitizes actionable remediation for Builder; does not authorize remote push.

fields.name: candidate_ref
fields.description: Required fixed candidate revision ID or immutable revision-set identifier evaluated during external review.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Reviewed requirements, boundaries, and change scope.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Review outcome disposition: PASS, FINDINGS, or INCOMPLETE.

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: Concrete observable evidence supporting the review disposition or reason for incompleteness.

fields.name: findings
fields.description: Optional structured actionable findings detailing defect location, severity, and description.

fields.name: verification_assessment
fields.description: Independent assessment of supplied verification evidence, test adequacy, and reproduction results.
